ValidationRule.description: Not Allow to Change Seat Sales Tracking after case status Request for Ticketing
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
And(
Ischanged( Total_Seat_Sales__c ),
Text(Case_ID__r.Status )!= "New", Text(Case_ID__r.Status )!= "Ticket Sales in Progress", NOT(CONTAINS(Text(Case_ID__r.Status), "Adhoc"))
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Not Allow to Change Seat Sales Tracking after case status Request for Ticketing
